rail.title: Турция завершила строительство 153 км высокоскоростной железной дороги к границе с Болгарией
rail.summary_en: В Турции завершено строительство 153-километрового участка высокоскоростной железной дороги Черкезкей – Капыкуле, ведущего к границе с Болгарией. Официальное открытие линии запланировано на 9 октября, в церемонии примет участие президент Турции Реджеп Тайип Эрдоган.
rail.content: 05.10.2026 16:19:17 В Турции завершено строительство 153-километрового участка высокоскоростной железной дороги Черкезкей – Капыкуле, ведущего к границе с Болгарией. Официальное открытие линии запланировано на 9 октября, в церемонии примет участие президент Турции Реджеп Тайип Эрдоган. «Мы расширяем нашу сеть высокоскоростных поездов от Черкезкея до Капыкуле, вплоть до европейской границы», – заявил министр транспорта и инфраструктуры Турции Абдулкадир Уралоглу. Новый участок позволит подключить Текирдаг, Кыркларели и Эдирне к сети высокоскоростных железных дорог страны. Линия предназначена как для пассажирского, так и для грузового движения. Ее максимальная расчетная скорость составляет 200 км/ч. Строительство участка началось в 2019 году и велось при финансовой поддержке Турции и Европейского союза. Участок Черкезкей – Капыкуле является частью более крупного железнодорожного проекта Халкалы – Капыкуле, который должен связать Стамбул с турецко-болгарской границей в районе Капыкуле – Капитан-Андреево. После завершения всего проекта время поездки между Халкалы в Стамбуле и Капыкуле планируется сократить с четырех часов до 1 часа 30 минут. Время перевозки грузов по этому маршруту должно уменьшиться с 8 часов 30 минут примерно до 3 часов 30 минут. По словам Абдулкадира Уралоглу, строительство остальных участков железной дороги Халкалы – Капыкуле продолжается. Новая магистраль должна улучшить пассажирское железнодорожное сообщение между Турцией и Болгарией, а также увеличить возможности для грузовых перевозок между Турцией и европейскими странами. Проект интегрирован в один из ключевых транспортных коридоров, связывающих Турцию с Европейским союзом. rail.title: Операторский бизнес: куда повернет ветер перемен
rail.content: На конференции «Операторский бизнес: экономика, качество, взаимодействие с рынком» обсудили широкий круг вопросов – от изменения структуры операторского рынка до финансового состояния операторов и их партнеров, а также качества обслуживания грузовладельцев. В конференции приняли участие около сотни участников. Сколько стоит вагон Одной из ключевых тем стал обмен мнениями о том, насколько сложившийся уровень ставок операторов позволяет сохранить оптимальный баланс спроса и предложения на рынке. В частности, сложившийся уровень ставок доходности операторов поддерживает экспортеров угля. Ставки существенно снизились по сравнению с прошлым годом, считает заместитель генерального директора ИПЕМ Владимир Савчук. По его словам, ставки доходности поддерживаются наиболее высокими в том случае, если подвижной состав используется на восточном направлении, когда после выгрузки угля полувагон загружается контейнерами с импортом. Тогда ставка доходности для операторов оказывается вдвое выше. Правда, доля таких рейсов в общем объеме перевозок угля составляет всего несколько процентов. Тем не менее, она растет. До середины 2021 года высокие экспортные цены и низкий тариф РЖД позволяли существенно увеличить цены предоставления вагонов под перевозку. При этом в целом доходность оперирования вагонами сократилась. Причем динамика ставок оказалась ниже уровня инфляции. При этом по состоянию на октябрь 2026 года тарифы РЖД выросли в 13,3 раза по сравнению с 2003 годом. Иными словами, тарифы росли быстрее инфляции. Свое видение вопросов, связанных с рынком оперирования, представил руководитель проектов (аналитика и консалтинг) ROLLINGSTOCK Agency Александр Слободяник. Из сказанного следовало, что при существующем уровне ставок приобретение, например, полувагона в лизинг может и не окупиться. В свою очередь управляющий директор по лизингу подвижного состава ГК «ВТБ Лизинг» Оксана Ивановская назвала ставку аренды полувагона, близкую к той, что приводится в исследовании РЖД-Партнера «Ставки и грузовые вагоны» . Она заметила, что полувагон не окупается у тех операторов, кто приобретал его на пике высоких цен у вагоностроительных заводов, когда полувагон с нагрузкой на ось 25 тс стоил 7 млн руб. При цене около 5 млн руб. вагон все-таки окупается. Тем более что значительная часть лизингополучателей прошли в 2026 году реструктуризацию платежей. Новые сделки заключаются только с повышенным первоначальным взносом, что опять-таки позволяет оптимизировать условия сделки в нынешних условиях. Однако для нормального развития рынка ставка доходности полувагона должна составлять 4 тыс. руб./сут. К этой планке она и будет стремиться при улучшении конъюнктуры. В этом должно помочь заключение договоров о взаимодействии перевозчика с операторами, считает генеральный директор ООО «Нефтехимическая транспортная компания» Александр Сапронов. Эта практика помогает особенно эффективно организовать перевозки маршрутами. И со стороны перевозчика есть понимание того, какие решения принимать, если оператору приходится перестраивать часть отправок, если меняется ситуация у клиентов. Правда, часть операторов отметили сложности с выполнением предложенных перевозчиком полигонных технологий и квот на перемещение порожнего парка. Трансформация логистики Участники конференции пришли к выводу, что спрос на подвижной состав будет меняться на фоне очередного витка трансформации логистики. Эксперты отметили, что в сентябре уже стал заметен разворот вагонопотоков не только на восток, но и на северо-запад . Однако для ОАО «РЖД» это оказалось неожиданностью. В результате на Северо-Западном полигоне сконцентрировалось значительное количество порожних вагонов, отметил руководитель Департамента железнодорожных перевозок АО «Росхим» Александр Киревнин. Уточним, что общее количество вагонов на полигоне северо-запада (ОЖД плюс СЖД) превысило нормативы перевозчика на 121 тыс. ед., что составило почти половину сетевого превышения указанного показателя. На МЖД превышение составило 30 тыс. ед. (при норме около 100 тыс. вагонов). Дорога встала по всем направлениям. Объезд через ПривЖД – КбшЖД – ГЖД привел к скоплению сверх нормы на полигоне КбшЖД еще 33 тыс. ед. Всего на сети избыток превысил 243 тыс. вагонов. Тем не менее, считают эксперты, на ОЖД способны пропустить гораздо больше вагонов. Ведь в предыдущие годы ОЖД показывало лучший результат, чем сейчас. Это вопрос технологий. Собственно, что первично – бороться с «лишними» вагонами на сети или все-таки искать технологии для пропуска максимально востребованного объема грузов на Балтику и морские порты Арктики. В качестве удачного примера привлечения дополнительных объемов на сеть старший аналитик ЦЦИ Роман Шагалов привел скидки с тарифа перевозчика на металлы: они помогли активнее загружать вагоны. Причем даже на низком рынке, который сейчас сложился для перевозок черных металлов. Добавим, что это не привело к росту ставок операторов на аренду парка под данную номенклатуру. Ставки выросли в конце лета только на тот подвижной сост

rail.title: РЖД испытали робота для отпуска и проверки тормозов грузовых вагонов
rail.summary_en: РЖД провели приемочные испытания отечественного робота, предназначенного для отпуска и проверки тормозов грузовых вагонов. Тестирование прошло на сортировочной станции Челябинск-Главный, где в рамках проекта «Цифровая железнодорожная станция» испытываются новые технические решения.
rail.content: 05.10.2026 15:23:24 РЖД испытали робота для отпуска и проверки тормозов грузовых вагонов РЖД провели приемочные испытания отечественного робота, предназначенного для отпуска и проверки тормозов грузовых вагонов. Тестирование прошло на сортировочной станции Челябинск-Главный, где в рамках проекта «Цифровая железнодорожная станция» испытываются новые технические решения. Операции по отпуску и проверке тормозов необходимы на сортировочных станциях для проведения маневровой работы с вагонами. Во время испытаний автоматизированный комплекс отпустил тормоза почти у 5 тыс. вагонов. В РЖД рассчитывают, что роботизация позволит отказаться от ручного выполнения этой операции на опасном участке инфраструктуры, а также ускорить обработку составов. Первый отечественный робот для выполнения технологических операций на железнодорожном транспорте разработан НИИАС совместно с российскими производителями робототехники. Комплекс размещен на мобильной гусеничной платформе и способен самостоятельно перемещаться по междупутьям станции. Для навигации робот использует лидары и камеры технического зрения, а непосредственно отпуск тормозов выполняет с помощью манипулятора. Сейчас такие комплексы размещают в парках станции Челябинск-Главный. В дальнейшем РЖД планируют внедрить роботов на 25 ключевых сортировочных станциях сети. rail.title: Инновационный вагон больше времени находится в рабочем парке
rail.summary_en: Вагон с улучшенными характеристиками не только перевозит больше груза за один рейс, но и эксплуатируется с более высокой интенсивностью. Среднегодовой пробег у самой распространенной модели инновационного вагона - полувагона модели 12-9853 с осевой нагрузкой 25 тс, составляет 120,8 тыс. км против 49,3 тыс. км у вагона типовой модели.
rail.content: 05.10.2026 13:44:49 Инновационный вагон больше времени находится в рабочем парке Вагон с улучшенными характеристиками не только перевозит больше груза за один рейс, но и эксплуатируется с более высокой интенсивностью. Среднегодовой пробег у самой распространенной модели инновационного вагона - полувагона модели 12-9853 с осевой нагрузкой 25 тс, составляет 120,8 тыс. км против 49,3 тыс. км у вагона типовой модели. Сравнительный анализ инновационного и типового парка представил на конференции «Операторский бизнес: экономика, качество, взаимодействие с рынком» руководитель направления по техническому развитию дирекции сервиса ПАО «НПК ОВК» Сергей Джепко. Срок службы полувагона ОВК 25 тс – 32 года, что почти в 1,5 раза больше, чем у стандартного подвижного состава. Другой плюс – увеличенные межремонтные интервалы и ресурсы. Если деповской ремонт для типового вагона нужно проводить фактически каждые 2-3 года, то для инновации – через 8 лет. При этом инновационный парк надежнее в эксплуатации, что влияет на количество отцепочных ремонтов. «На всех этапах коэффициент отцепки нашего вагона в текущий ремонт значительно ниже, чем у типового вагона. Наш вагон отцепляется от 2 до 4 раз реже в ТОР и, таким образом, больше находится в рабочем парке», – говорит С. Джепко. Так, на начальном этапе эксплуатации (1-3 года) у типового вагона на тележке тип 2 удельный коэффициент отцепок в ТР-1 и ТР-2 на 100 тыс. км возрастает лавинообразно – с 0,09 до 0,91. Полувагон модели 12-9853 демонстрирует стабильность. Коэффициент отцепок у него держится на уровне от 0,01 до 0,26. На следующем этапе (4-8 лет) у стандартного вагона удельное число отцепок фиксируется на высоких отметках – 1,02-1,49 на 100 тыс. км. У модели ОВК этот показатель варьируется в пределах 0,37-0,65. В дальнейшем (9-14 лет) стандартные вагоны выходят на пик отказов (до 1,55 внеплановых ремонтов). Инновационный подвижной состав имеет удельный коэффициент всего 0,66-0,80. В числе конструкционных преимуществ вагонов 25 тс – кассетные подшипники и износостойкость колесных пар. Инновационная тележка полувагона модели 12-9853 обеспечивает улучшенное вписывание в кривые малого радиуса и снижает боковое воздействие на рельс. rail.content: 05.10.2026 09:41:17 Объем товаропотока через железнодорожные пункты пропуска Калининградской области за январь – август 2026 года сократился на 18% по сравнению с аналогичным периодом прошлого года, до 2,3 млн тонн. Об этом сообщил начальник Калининградской областной таможни Денис Партоменко. Перевозки через автомобильные пункты пропуска также снизились – на 7%, до 630 тыс. тонн. За восемь месяцев морским путем между Калининградской областью и основной территорией России перевезено почти 2,7 млн тонн грузов, что на 17% больше, чем годом ранее. В Калининградскую область доставлено около 2 млн тонн, в обратном направлении – 642 тыс. тонн. China-Europe logistics market Demand China’s trade growth with the EU remains below the overall dynamics of China’s foreign trade. In January-August, China-EU trade turnover grew by 8.1% YoY, compared to 17.6% for China’s foreign trade overall [ NBS PRC ]. In August, exports to the EU increased by approximately 6.6% YoY, following 16% in July. External forecasts point to continued growth in Chinese exports; however, weak import demand dynamics in Europe may limit further expansion of China-EU trade. Moreover, there are prerequisites for further slowdown. The EU is stepping up measures to reduce its trade imbalance with China. The European Union states its readiness to make more active use of trade instruments and expects results from negotiations with China by October [ Reuters ]. At the same time, the possibility of voluntary restrictions on supplies of Chinese hybrid vehicles to the EU is being discussed. The measures are still at the discussion stage; however, their implementation could affect one of the significant segments of Chinese exports and the cargo base for container shipping. Demand for Asia-Europe sea freight remains subdued [ Drewry ]. A short-term boost could come from increased shipments ahead of China’s Golden Week (October 1-7), but no signs of strengthening demand have yet been observed. In January-August, the volume of China-Europe-China rail container transportation increased by 26% YoY. The Central Eurasian Corridor contributed significantly to this growth ( +22% YoY). A sharp increase in volumes on the Middle Corridor was also recorded over the past two months (to 9.8 and 7.8 thousand TEU, respectively), driven by higher shipments to Azerbaijan, Georgia, and Turkey. rail.summary_en: At the end of the first half of 2026, in June, the WCI Drewry Index reached $3,939, outperforming the ERAI rate ($3,704 per FEU) for the first time since January 2025. The WCI for the Shanghai—Rotterdam route closely approached the ERAI, reaching $3,579 per FEU by early June. According to ERAI data , this trend continued in July. The peak in ocean freight rates in June and then July was driven by
rail.content: At the end of the first half of 2026, in June, the WCI Drewry Index reached $3,939, outperforming the ERAI rate ($3,704 per FEU) for the first time since January 2025. The WCI for the Shanghai—Rotterdam route closely approached the ERAI, reaching $3,579 per FEU by early June. According to ERAI data , this trend continued in July. The peak in ocean freight rates in June and then July was driven by the onset of the peak season for maritime cargo demand, the persistent fuel factor, as well as delays and disruptions. Pressure on available carrying capacity came from a shortage of containers in Chinese ports, as well as operational difficulties at Northern European ports. In the second half of the year, ocean freight rates are expected to stabilize and even gradually decline as seasonal demand is met, delays and disruptions ease (particularly in Asia), and overall fleet capacity increases. At the same time, the persistence of military-political risks that affect fuel costs, vessel schedules and routes, and consequently available carrying capacity, will remain a restraining factor for price reductions. This points to a likely ‘soft landing’ scenario for the second half of the year. In the first half of 2026, at least 275,000 TEU passed along the central Eurasian railway route in total, which is 10.7% less than the figure for the same period in 2025 (307,800 TEU). At the same time, however, transit traffic volumes on the China—Europe—China route showed steady growth, increasing by 32.8% (from 138,400 to 183,800 TEU). The growth in the transit segment was driven by shipping on the China — Europe route. Volumes along this route increased by 39.0%, from 118.7 to 165.0 thousand TEU. At the same time, the figures for the first half of 2026 slightly exceeded those for the same period in 2024. The reverse route (Europe—China) remained at roughly the same level, with a slight decline of 4.5% (from 19.7 to 18.8 thousand TEU). The China—Europe flow thus served as the main driver of central Eurasian rail traffic in the reporting period. As has been the case, the key commodity categories transported along the central Eurasian railway route remain electrical devices, mechanical equipment, and motor vehicles. In the first half of 2026, the total volume of shipments in these categories amounted to approximately 59.7 thousand TEU, which is 27.7% higher than during the same period in 2025 (46.8 thousand TEU). rail.title: Transport and logistics indexes: classification and advantages
rail.summary_en: Transport and logistics indexes are quantitative indicators designed to assess the state of transportation across various routes, modes of transport, and other parameters. Depending on the objectives of the analysis, they can reflect the level of development of logistics infrastructure in individual countries, specific market segments (for example, the dynamics of container shipping rates for key
rail.content: Transport and logistics indexes are quantitative indicators designed to assess the state of transportation across various routes, modes of transport, and other parameters. Depending on the objectives of the analysis, they can reflect the level of development of logistics infrastructure in individual countries, specific market segments (for example, the dynamics of container shipping rates for key international trade routes), or assess market conditions (such as surveys). Transport and logistics indexes are divided into volume and price indexes, reflecting the physical and cost parameters of delivery, respectively. There are also qualitative indexes based on expert assessments or surveys. From an economic perspective, price indexes are the most practical, as they allow for the direct assessment of transportation costs and reflect market conditions. There are various types of indexes, primarily price indexes and survey indexes (based on expert assessments). This study focuses primarily on price indexes, which also vary depending on the mode of transport, type of cargo, route geography, and, of course, methodology. The use of standardized units of measurement makes transport and logistics indexes a universal tool for market analysis. In container shipping, the units of measurement typically used are twenty-foot containers (TEU) and forty-foot (FEU) containers. In the air transport sector, specialized units known as ULDs (Unit Load Devices) are used. However, to ensure comparability with other modes of shipping, the cost can be expressed in US dollars per kilogram or per metric ton. Indexes play a particularly important role in benchmarking, allowing transport companies to assess the competitiveness of their rates (tariffs), and shippers to evaluate the efficiency of their logistics. In recent years, certain indexes have begun to be used to set rates for contracts, with freight costs automatically adjusted based on changes in a selected market indicator. With proper development and the necessary demand, exchange-traded financial instruments can be set up based on a given index; for example, futures on transportation, the most famous of which are SCFIS (Europe) Futures, traded on the Shanghai International Energy Exchange (INE), which reflects actual rates for container shipping. rail.title: High-Speed Railway to Link Moscow and Minsk
rail.summary_en: The new mainline will be some 715 km long.
rail.content: RF transport minister Andrey Nikitin and Belarussian transport and communications minister Aleksey Lyakhnovich have signed a bipartite memorandum on cooperation in designing and constructing a high-speed railway between Moscow and Minsk, the RF Government press office said. The new mainline will be some 715 km long. The specialized rolling stock to run the new railway will be capable of operating at a speed up to 400 km per hour thus cutting the travelling time between the two capitals from the current 7-9 hours to just 3 hours. The passenger flow between Moscow and Minsk is expected to grow up to 5.8 million people per annum. Active construction on the Minsk section of the railway is to start after the key objects of the first high-speed railway between Moscow and St. Petersburg are put into operation. Photo: RF Government press office

rail.content: Another RSD59 Project dry cargo vessel has been delivered to the customer by Krasnoe Sormovo shipyard, United Shipbuilding Company said in a statement. The vessel left the yard and set sail for her operating area after completing mooring and navigation trials when her propulsion system, navigation equipment and automation systems were tested. RSD59 project dry cargo ships are the backbone of Russia’s modern river-sea-going class fleet. Due to their characteristics they can operate both in inland waterways and in sea areas. This type of vessels is designed for shipping general cargo and breakbulk, sawn goods, logs, metal scrap, high and heavy cargo, and hazardous materials. rail.title: Coffee Import to Siberia in January-July 2026
rail.summary_en: More than half of the entire imports originates from Brazil.
rail.content: During the first seven months of 2026, 462 tons of natural coffee was imported to the Siberian federal region, the RF Federal Customs said in its social media channel. 84% of the total was arabica, both ground coffee and coffee beans. More than half of the entire imports originates from Brazil. Other exporters include Columbia, Guatemala, Mexico, Ethiopia, Viet Nam, and Kenya. The major importer among the Siberian regions was Novosibirsk region accounting for 82%, or 382 tons. Other major importers were Krasnoyarsk region (43%) and Irkutsk region (37%). Instant coffee import made 153 tons. The major exporter to Siberia is Viet Nam. Photo: RF Federal Customs Service

The train carrying 152 TEU left the station of origin on September 28. On arrival at Vladivostok, the cargo will be loaded on board a FESCO-operated vessel and delivered to Xingang in China in the framework of FESCO China Direct Line. The expected transit time by rail from Timashevskaya to Vladivostok is 12 days, and that by sea from Vladivostok to China is 7 days. The Timashevskaya to Vladivostok rail service frequency is twice a month. The backhaul service is also available. rail.title: Rhenus Group to continue development of multimodal container terminal project in Aktau.
rail.content: ЦТС German international logistics group Rhenus Group has signed an agreement with the operator of the Port of Aktau to continue developing plans for a trimodal container terminal in Kazakhstan. The next stage will focus on analysing potential cargo flows and assessing the technical and economic feasibility of the project. The terminal is planned to handle cargo between maritime, rail and road transport. The project envisages a terminal covering at least 30 hectares, with a planned annual capacity of at least 150,000 TEU. The facility is being developed as part of the Trans-Caspian International Transport Route (TITR), which connects China and Central Asia with European markets via the Caspian Sea. Rhenus sees the project as part of the expansion of its logistics network along the TITR. In early 2026, the group also acquired a rail terminal in Kazakhstan’s Almaty Region, strengthening its presence in the country and creating additional opportunities for multimodal transport along the route. Source: https://cfts.org.ua/

rail.title: Europe overtakes Asia in global rail market.
rail.content: The global railway industry market is expected to exceed EUR 275 billion by 2030, according to the latest assessment by SCI Verkehr. The consultancy forecasts average annual growth of 3.9% through the end of the decade. Europe is now the largest regional market, with an average annual market volume of EUR 77.7 billion in 2024–2026. Asia follows at EUR 73.9 billion, according to SCI Verkehr’s Worldwide Market for Railway Industries 2026 study. The change reflects different investment cycles across the two regions. Europe is benefiting from large-scale fleet renewal, signalling projects and continued investment in established rail networks, while the Chinese market is losing some of the momentum generated by years of rapid network and fleet expansion. Europe grows above global average SCI Verkehr expects the European rail industry market to grow by an average of 4.4% annually between 2025 and 2030, above the global forecast of 3.9%. Renewal of existing rail systems is one of the main drivers. Fleet procurement programmes, ETCS deployment, digital signalling and urban rail projects are all contributing to demand, while high-speed rail is providing additional growth in the passenger segment. Asia remains close behind Europe in absolute market size but is expected to grow more slowly, at around 3.0% annually. China is shifting from the rapid expansion phase of previous years towards greater demand for fleet renewal and after-sales services. India and markets in South-East Asia continue to expand, but SCI Verkehr says their growth is not large enough to fully compensate for the slowdown in China. Passenger rail leads global growth Passenger transport is currently the main driver of growth in the global rail industry. SCI Verkehr points in particular to the recovery of passenger rail following the pandemic and to continued investment in urban transport systems. Urbanisation, expansion of existing metro and light rail networks and new projects in growing metropolitan areas are supporting the strongest growth rates within the passenger rail technology market. High-speed rail is another significant growth segment, particularly in Europe, where several large procurement and infrastructure programmes are under way. The regional picture also shows relatively strong growth outside the two largest markets. rail.title: 河南首趟精深加工肉制品冷链班列发往东盟
rail.content: 近日，一列满载冻肉、培根等冷冻肉制品的冷链班列从郑州国际陆港缓缓驶出，开往老挝万象。这是河南首次通过冷链班列，将本地精深加工肉类制品发往东盟市场。本次班列全程恒温冷藏、温控全程可溯源，将这批特色“中原味道”跨越数千公里，端上东南亚消费者的餐桌。 此次开行的东盟方向冷冻肉制品冷链班列，是郑州国际陆港在东盟冷链运输领域的重要突破，标志着郑州国际陆港依托“班列＋产业”联动模式开拓东南亚市场迈出关键一步，为区域冷链产业高质量发展注入全新动能。 相较于以往出口品类，本次发运货物具有标志性意义。此前，河南出口农产品多为大蒜、胡萝卜等初级生鲜品类，如今冻肉、培根等精深加工肉类制品顺利出海，实现了从“田间地头”到“加工车间”、从“原料出海”到“成品出海”的跨越。品类的迭代拓展，直观折射出河南食品工业从“原料输出”向“高附加值产品输出”的产业结构升级，推动中原食品产业以更高品质、更高附加值深度融入全球供应链体系。 随着冷链班列服务功能持续完善、国际物流网络不断织密，更多“豫字号”优质产品将依托中欧班列（郑州）走出国门，持续为内陆开放高地建设和区域协调发展赋能增效。下一步，郑州国际陆港将持续深耕冷链物流领域，推动东盟方向冷链班列常态化、规模化运营，充分释放“班列＋产业”联动集聚效应，惠及更多本土外贸企业。 （来源：中国水运报） 版权与免责声明： 此稿件为引述消息报道，稿件版权归原作者所有，Landbridge平台不对本稿件内容真实性负责。如发现政治性、事实性、技术性差错和版权方面的问题及不良信息，请及时与我们联系，并提供稿件的【 纠错信息 】。纠错热线：0518-85806682

rail.title: 国家铁路前8月发送货物26.9亿吨 中欧（亚）班列开行增长9.7%
rail.content: 今年1至8月，国家铁路累计发送货物26.9亿吨，在重点物资运输、铁路物流产品提质升级、中欧（亚）班列开行等方面较去年同期均实现增长。 重点物资方面，1至8月国家铁路共计发送煤炭13.89亿吨，其中电煤9.28亿吨；粮食、化工、纺织品类货物运量分别同比增长9.9%、5.5%和21.7%。 物流产品方面，1至8月国家铁路累计签订物流总包合同1567个，合同运量达13亿吨；“客车化”快捷班列同比增长37%，匹配电商、冷链等快捷物流市场需求；铁水联运“一单制”产品与铁公联运“门到门”全程物流服务今年上半年均实现双增长。 中欧（亚）班列方面，今年以来铁路部门持续推进与国外铁路部门的协作，累计开行24605列，同比增长9.7%。 （来源：观点地产网） 版权与免责声明： 此稿件为引述消息报道，稿件版权归原作者所有，Landbridge平台不对本稿件内容真实性负责。如发现政治性、事实性、技术性差错和版权方面的问题及不良信息，请及时与我们联系，并提供稿件的【 纠错信息 】。纠错热线：0518-85806682

rail.title: 重庆开行首趟零碳绿色中欧班列 中国物流与德铁货运联合运营
rail.content: 9月21日，重庆中欧班列首趟零碳绿色班列从团结村中心车站始发，这是重庆开行的首趟零碳绿色中欧班列。 该班列由中国物流所属渝新欧公司与德铁货运（DB Cargo）联合运营，满载日用百货、消费型锂电池、家装产品等货物，经阿拉山口口岸出境，最终驶向德国杜伊斯堡。 据中国物流消息，该班列全程采用绿色低碳运输方案，在电气化铁路区段使用绿色电力驱动列车，在非电气化区段则通过经国际认证的碳抵消项目对剩余排放进行等量补偿，实现列车运行全程碳中和。 据介绍，铁路运输碳排放仅为公路运输的五分之一，零碳绿色班列在此基础上进一步实现全链条碳中和。 中国物流表示，面对欧盟碳关税等国际绿色贸易规则持续升级，零碳绿色班列的开行为外贸企业提供了切实的合规路径。中国物流介绍，企业可按需获得由德铁货运颁发的绿色货运证书，并据此申报欧盟企业年度财务报表，凭碳积分享受相关国家的免税政策，以规避供应链碳合规风险。将以此次班列开行为起点，持续完善绿色班列运营机制，逐步扩大绿色运输覆盖面。 （来源：观点地产网） 版权与免责声明： 此稿件为引述消息报道，稿件版权归原作者所有，Landbridge平台不对本稿件内容真实性负责。如发现政治性、事实性、技术性差错和版权方面的问题及不良信息，请及时与我们联系，并提供稿件的【 纠错信息 】。纠错热线：0518-85806682

rail.title: 成都中欧班列集结中心雅安基地挂牌，13家企业已明确合作意向
rail.content: 9月23日，成都中欧班列集结中心雅安基地正式挂牌。这是成都中欧班列集结中心在四川布局的第10个支撑基地，标志着川西地区正式接入成都“中欧班列+西部陆海新通道”集结网络。 现场，成都国际陆港运营有限公司与四川雅州新区物流园区发展有限责任公司完成《双港联动战略合作协议》签约，发布雅安企业市场需求清单和成都国际班列服务供给清单，并举行发车组货仪式。目前，已有13家雅安企业明确国际货运合作意向，预计年货运量58.8万吨。 第10个基地落地 成雅共建“枢纽+分拨节点”集散体系 据了解，成都中欧班列集结中心已先后在德阳、眉山、资阳、乐山、达州、泸州、宜宾、广元、自贡9个市州布局基地。雅安基地的挂牌，是落实《四川省推动中欧班列集结中心枢纽体系建设三年行动方案》、加快推进成都中欧班列集结中心建设的关键落子。 根据《双港联动战略合作协议》，双方将聚焦通道协同、产业协同、平台融合、协同联动四大核心，构建“枢纽+分拨节点”集散体系，遵循“去程统一集拼、回程协同分拨”原则，深化中亚班列等国际线路合作，共同组织货源，共建信息共享机制。 成都市口岸物流办相关负责人表示，雅安基地的挂牌运营，有效补齐了成都国际铁路港西向国际货运承载和集散能力短板，为成都中欧班列集结中心“1+N”枢纽体系建设拼上了关键一环。 13家雅安企业明确合作意向 矿石、茶叶、水产等将搭班列出海 雅安地处川西咽喉，素有“西藏门户”“民族走廊”之称，是重要的物流节点。近年来，雅安主动融入开放大局，与成都口岸物流合作日益深化：茶叶乘中亚班列抵达中东，花椒油借中老班列香飘东盟，宝兴汉白玉经铁海联运直达意大利，光学玻璃沿中欧中线高效回程入川。 今年以来，雅安聚焦货源组织、通道建设、平台搭建，扎实推进雅安基地各项前期工作。目前，全市已有13家企业明确国际货运合作意向，货物品类涵盖矿石、化工原料、茶叶、水果、水产等，预计年货运量可达58.8万吨，折合2.94万标准集装箱，为基地起步运营打下坚实基础。 “雅安基地挂牌让我们在家门口就能通过成都国际班列发运货物，运输时效大幅提升，物流成本也有望降低。”四川雅化实业集团运输有限公司董事长兼总经理邹庆表示，公司主要从事锂矿石等产品运输，未来计划通过中亚班列、中老班列拓展进口渠道，同时研究中欧班列开拓欧洲市场。 四川雅洲民生物流有限公司总经理张欢欢则表示，基地挂牌只是起步，真正让国际班列通道持续释放效能，关键要靠市场化运营。公司将持续做好货源组织，深入摸排全市外贸企业运输需求，推动更多雅安企业利用成都国际班列拓展国际市场。 雅安经开区相关负责人表示，将依托雅安基地重点培育三类适铁产业：特色农产品，包括茶叶、花椒油、鱼子酱、水果等；新材料产品，包括汉白玉、光学玻璃等；化工产品，依托雅安丰富的磷矿、锂矿资源拓展国际市场。 雅安企业“家门口”提货 成雅实现“去程集拼、回程分拨” 活动现场，成都市口岸物流办给雅安企业送来一揽子服务承诺：重点企业可享“优先受理、优先排班、优先保障”；“班列管家”将直接进园区、进企业，目标是“班列事园区办、企业订舱不出园”；“一单制”全程联运、在途货物质押融资等创新成果也将向雅安企业开放；两地还将建立货源共育、线路共商、信息共享的常态化机制。 成都港投公司相关负责人介绍，雅安企业通过成都国际班列运输可享受订舱、用箱、通关三方面便利：专属订舱账号实现“一键订舱”，推广“铁路快通”模式实现“本地报关、口岸放行”。 “我们按照‘去程统一集拼、回程协同分拨’原则，推动雅安货源与成都枢纽高效联动。”该负责人表示，去程方面，雅安及周边地区货物在雅安集结后运至成都国际铁路港统一集拼发运；回程方面，进口货物抵达成都后通过分拨网络转运至雅安，企业可在本地提货，真正实现“生产在雅安、集散在成都”。 “基地挂牌只是起步，关键是把服务做实。”雅安市相关负责人表示，下一步将建立“一对一”专属对接机制，落实运价下浮、专项补贴等政策，并为企业提供报关报检、出口退税、跨境合规等一站式服务。 据悉，成都国际班列已累计开行超4万列，连接境外城市140个。成都市口岸物流办相关负责人表示，下一步将推动国际班列服务从“覆盖园区”向“服务市州”延伸，持续深化“班列进市州”行动，计划实现全省10个成都中欧班列集结中心支撑基地全覆盖，推动从“企业找班列”转变为“班列服务找企业”。 （来源：红星新闻） 版权与免责声明： 此稿件为引述消息报道，稿件版权归原作者所有，Landbridge平台不对本稿件内容真实性负责。如发现政治性、事实性、技术性差错和版权方面的问题及不良信息，请及时与我们联系，并提供稿件的【 纠错信息 】。纠错热线：0518-85806682

rail.title: 今年前八个月贵阳国际陆港，“四向”班列发运量同比增长53.2%
rail.content: 记者从贵州铁投集团获悉，今年前八个月，贵阳国际陆港累计发运中欧（亚）班列、西部陆海新通道班列、黔粤班列、中老班列“四向”班列23178标箱，发运量同比增长53.2%，其中西部陆海新通道班列发运10802标箱。 贵州铁投集团旗下贵州省多式联运产业发展有限公司副总经理刘贤表示，公司积极推进“四向”班列开行，统筹班列组织与货源整合，有力助推贵州融入“一带一路”和西部陆海新通道建设。针对贵州货源“点多、量散、规模小”、缺乏稳定集货基地的实际，公司在各市（州）铁路货场网点拓展集货业务，将分散的运输需求整合为规模化的单点运力，有效提高班列装载效率与装箱率。 今年以来，在贵阳海关的支持帮助下，贵州铁投集团积极推广应用“一港通”“铁路快通”快速通关模式，创新通道运营机制，提升贵阳国际陆港货物通关效率，目前已实现黔货在贵阳国际陆港一次性完成申报、查验、放行全流程海关手续。 （来源：动静新闻） 版权与免责声明： 此稿件为引述消息报道，稿件版权归原作者所有，Landbridge平台不对本稿件内容真实性负责。如发现政治性、事实性、技术性差错和版权方面的问题及不良信息，请及时与我们联系，并提供稿件的【 纠错信息 】。纠错热线：0518-85806682

trade.title: Moscow Court Jails Ex-Sochi Mayor for 15 Years in Prison in Corruption Case
trade.summary_en: Alexei Kopaygorodsky served as mayo until May 2024, when he abruptly resigned, citing a transition to a federal post.
trade.content: A Moscow judge has sentenced the former mayor of the Black Sea resort city of Sochi to 15 years in maximum-security prison for corruption, state media reported Monday, citing the Russian Prosecutor General’s Office. Alexei Kopaygorodsky, 41, served as mayor from September 2019 until May 2024, when he abruptly resigned, citing a transition to a federal post. After the transfer failed to materialize, Kopaygorodsky joined a volunteer army battalion fighting in Ukraine. He was arrested in the Russian-occupied Luhansk region of eastern Ukraine in September 2024 and transferred to Moscow, where prosecutors sought 21 years in prison for him and 16 years for his wife. The Meshchansky District Court found Kopaygorodsky guilty of receiving large-scale bribes, embezzling municipal property and laundering criminal proceeds, according to Interfax. His wife Yanina Kopaygorodskaya was sentenced to 10 years in prison for serving as an accomplice, while her assistant Alexander Pasunko was fined 190,000 rubles ($2,200). Kopaygorodsky and his wife were also ordered to pay fines of half a billion rubles ($5.9 million) each. In addition, the former mayor was stripped of his state medal, banned from holding public management roles for 14.5 years and will face three additional years after his prison term. Prosecutors accused Kopaygorodsky of embezzling two municipal land plots and concealing their origin, as well as accepting more than 319 million rubles ($3.7 million) in bribes from business leaders and developers in exchange for favors and protection in 2022-24. Kopaygorodskaya was also accused of threatening one witness in order to receive false testimony and bribing another witness through Pasunko with half a million rubles ($5,900) while under house arrest. Both denied the charges. Earlier in January, a Sochi court seized the family’s assets worth more than 1.6 billion rubles ($18.8 million). Kopaygorodsky is among at least 10 current and former deputy governors who have faced criminal prosecution since Veniamin Kondratyev became Krasnodar region governor in 2015. trade.title: Kremlin Downplays Estonia’s Troop Shift to Border, Plays Up Russia’s Intelligence Capabilities
trade.summary_en: The comments come in response to the Financial Times detailing Estonia’s strategic pivot toward an “active defense” posture.
trade.content: The Kremlin on Monday said Russia’s intelligence services were capable of monitoring military movements along the country’s borders, brushing aside reports that Estonia is shifting troops closer to the Russian border. “There should be no doubt that our Defense Ministry and other relevant services possess the necessary intelligence to properly monitor and assess the situation around our borders,” spokesman Dmitry Peskov told reporters during a daily briefing. His comments come in response to the Financial Times detailing Estonia’s strategic pivot toward an “active defense” posture after observing Russia’s military tactics in Ukraine. Under the updated doctrine, the Baltic nation of 1.3 million is moving primary combat units from northern Estonia’s Tapa to Jõhvi — 50 kilometers (31 miles) from the border with the Leningrad region. Estonia is also constructing new facilities in the border city of Narva to house up to 1,000 troops during a crisis. Instead of a doctrine involving efforts to “harry” invading Russian forces until the arrival of NATO reinforcements, Estonian military planners are now opting to “fight over every inch of territory.” The country is also acquiring drones and ballistic missiles capable of striking up to 300 kilometers (186 miles) inside Russian territory. Estonia, a former Soviet republic that has long had strained relations with Moscow, has been at the forefront of countering Russian security threats and has strongly backed Ukraine since Putin ordered the full-scale invasion in February 2022. The FT report comes amid escalating rhetoric between European officials and Russia. Martin Jaeger, the head of Germany's BND foreign intelligence agency, said Monday that Germany faces a real risk of entering a “violent conflict” with Russia as Moscow expands its “shadow war” of hybrid attacks across Europe. Jaeger warned that in the short term Russia could engage in “low-intensity military activities, particularly in the Baltic states.” Reuters contributed reporting. trade.title: Russia Sentences ‘Masyanya’ Creator to 4 Years in Absentia Over Anti-War Cartoon
trade.summary_en: Investigators said the show’s 2023 episode “Idoliada” contained calls for Russian servicemen to surrender, desert and disobey their commanders.
trade.content: A St. Petersburg court has sentenced Oleg Kuvaev, creator of the animated series “Masyanya,” to four years and one month in prison in absentia over an episode that investigators said urged Russian soldiers to surrender or desert. The city’s Nevsky District Court found Kuvaev guilty of publicly calling for actions against state security and failing to comply with obligations imposed on people designated as “foreign agents,” the city courts’ press service said . The court also barred him from publishing online or administering websites for four years. Kuvaev has lived in Israel since 2006. Investigators said Kuvaev’s 2023 episode “Idoliada,” the 169th installment of “Masyanya,” contained calls for Russian servicemen to surrender, desert and disobey their commanders. The episode also promoted “I Want to Live,” a Ukrainian project that helps Russian soldiers surrender, according to investigators. Case materials cited by the courts’ press service described the cartoon as expressing “ideological hatred and hostility” toward Russia’s government and officials, as well as opposition to the invasion, which Moscow calls a “special military operation.” Investigators argued that its verbal appeals were directed against Russian state security. Those allegations placed the cartoon’s political message at the center of the criminal case. According to the exiled news outlet Mediazona, the court questioned Justice Ministry expert Vladislav Ivanov and two viewers, Nikita Sotnikov and Nikita Grishchenko. The viewers objected to the episode’s portrayal of the Russian military, saying it mocked the Armed Forces and could lead audiences to side with Ukraine, Mediazona reported. The criminal case was opened three years ago. Russian authorities designated Kuvaev a “foreign agent” in December 2023. Kuvaev has continued to produce anti-war work from abroad, including an AI-generated animated video parodying the Soviet song “May There Always Be Sunshine” released in November 2025. The video depicted rag dolls dressed as Soviet schoolchildren, wearing red Young Pioneer neckerchiefs, flying on missiles above ruined cities and sheltering from bombardment. Its lyrics replaced the original song’s wish for peace with wishes for perpetual war and slaughter. Kuvaev presented the video as “new Russian children’s songs.” He has also said he hopes Russia will break up and its ethnic republics will become independent, contrasting that position with what he described as the views of the Russian opposition. Responding to the verdict, Kuvaev dismissed the proceedings. “There is really nothing to say,” he said in comments reported by the Astra Telegram channel . “Except perhaps: ‘I regret and express concern about the state of sanity in the rotten empire’.” This article was translated with the help of artificial intelligence and was reviewed by a Moscow Times editor before publication. trade.title: Soviet TV Hypnotist Anatoly Kashpirovsky Dies at 87
trade.summary_en: The famed Soviet-era psychic healer became famous with his televised mass hypnosis sessions during the perestroika and glasnost years.
trade.content: Anatoly Kashpirovsky, the Soviet-era hypnotist whose televised “healing sessions” drew enormous audiences in the late 1980s, died on Saturday in Moscow at the age of 87. “Anatoly Mikhailovich passed away from advanced cancer that had spread to his lungs and brain,” Kashpirovsky’s nephew Yury Mamayev told state media. “There was multiple organ failure, meaning that the affected organs simply stopped functioning as a result of the cancer,” the TASS news agency quoted Mamayev as saying. A representative said earlier that Kashpirovsky suffered “sudden” cardiac arrest following a sharp drop in blood pressure. Born in Soviet Ukraine in 1939, Kashpirovsky graduated from the Vinnitsa Medical Institute in 1962 and spent 25 years working as a psychiatrist in a regional psychiatric hospital. He became a household name in the 1980s as public interest in the occult grew across the country during Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev’s perestroika reforms. Soviet Central Television started airing his six-part program, “Health Sessions of Psychotherapist Anatoly Kashpirovsky,” in October 1989. Its audience was estimated at more than 200 million people. Following the Soviet collapse, Kashpirovsky entered politics, winning a seat in Russia’s first State Duma in 1993 on the nationalist Liberal Democratic Party (LDPR)’s ticket. In June 1995, he took part in negotiations during the Budyonnovsk hospital hostage crisis , convincing Chechen rebel warlord Shamil Basayev to release some of the 1,500 hostages but failing to persuade him to surrender. Later in life, Kashpirovsky clashed with health regulators over allegations that he was practicing folk medicine illegally. While the Russian Academy of Sciences dismissed his methods as “absolute pseudoscience,” Kashpirovsky defended his medical credentials and won multiple defamation lawsuits. He maintained a loyal following, touring and hosting “healing sessions” on YouTube until March this year. His funeral will be held on Thursday, Oct. 8, at Moscow’s Troyekurovskoye Cemetery, on the anniversary of his six-part television program’s premiere. trade.title: Ovechkin to Launch His Own Beer Brand in Russia
trade.summary_en: The NHL star is teaming up with a brewer built from Heineken’s former Russian assets to produce the OVI beer range.
trade.content: Washington Capitals star Alexander Ovechkin plans to launch his own beer brand in Russia with a producer owned by Arnest, a group that has rapidly expanded by buying the Russian businesses of departing Western companies. The OVI range will be produced by Bochkarev Breweries and is expected to go on sale before the end of 2026, the Kommersant newspaper reported Monday. It will include a classic lager, a lower-alcohol lager and an alcohol-free beer, priced at about 100 rubles ($1.18) per can. The venture brings together one of Russia’s best-known athletes, whose support for President Vladimir Putin has drawn renewed criticism abroad, and a company that has become a major beneficiary of the Western corporate exodus since Moscow’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine. “I have long wanted to create my own beer, one that I would enjoy drinking myself,” Ovechkin said in comments supplied to Kommersant by the brewer’s press office. He said he preferred pale beers with a clean, balanced taste. Bochkarev Breweries belongs to businessman Alexei Sagal’s Arnest group. Its brewing business was built around Heineken’s Russian assets, which Arnest acquired in 2023 for a symbolic 1 euro. The company produces brands including Bochkarev, Okhota and Krusovice and ranks third in Russia by beer production volume. Arnest’s expansion has extended well beyond brewing. In 2022, it bought aluminum packaging plants from Ball Corporation. It subsequently acquired Oriflame’s Russian assets, Heineken’s Russian business and Unilever’s operations in the country. In 2026, it bought Avon’s Russian business and agreed to acquire Reckitt’s assets. Alexei Dyumin, a former Putin bodyguard who now serves as secretary of Russia’s State Council, reportedly helped Sagal lobby for the Heineken and Unilever deals. The Bell has also reported ties between Sagal and Denis Manturov, who headed Russia’s Industry and Trade Ministry for many years. Sagal has attributed his success to approaching Western companies directly. For Ovechkin, the beer venture follows a fresh controversy over his political activities in Russia while playing for a U.S. team. In September, he appeared in a campaign video for the ruling United Russia party ahead of Russia’s State Duma elections. Asked about his decision afterward, he said: “I’m Russian and I support my country.” The video drew criticism in the the West. Latvia barred Ovechkin from entering the country, while the Ukrainian Canadian Congress called on Canada’s government to impose sanctions on him. U.S. Republican Representative Joe Wilson urged the NHL’s leadership to review Ovechkin’s participation in the political advertisement. Ovechkin has publicly supported Putin since at least 2017, when he founded the Putin Team movement. After Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, he said he supported peace and wanted the fighting to end as soon as possible. He has played for the Capitals since 2005. In April 2025, he broke Wayne Gretzky’s record for NHL regular-season goals, finishing the 2025-26 season with 929. trade.title: Krasnodar Mayor Resigns After Contentious Tenure
trade.summary_en: Naumov’s four-year tenure was marked by local protests and controversies over infrastructure and urban planning decisions.
trade.content: Yevgeny Naumov, the mayor of the southern Russian city of Krasnodar, announced his early resignation on Monday. Naumov, whose five-year term was set to expire in November 2027, did not explain the reason behind his departure. The Krasnodar City Duma accepted Naumov’s resignation and appointed First Deputy Mayor Dmitry Vasilyev as acting head of the city. The City Duma will select the city's next mayor from a shortlist presented by Governor Veniamin Kondratyev. Kondratyev initiated a new selection process for mayoral candidates last month. Born in Krasnodar in 1980, Naumov spent his career within the municipal and regional administration. Local lawmakers elected him mayor in November 2022. Naumov’s four-year tenure was marked by local protests and controversies over infrastructure and urban planning decisions. In January, he signed off on plans to build an Orthodox Church on the grounds of a riverside park despite opposition from residents. Since November 2025, more than 30,000 people have signed a petition demanding his resignation. A local court began hearing a lawsuit against Naumov’s administration over the construction project. Media reports say that residents objected to a general infrastructure plan adopted by the city under Naumov’s leadership, with some 27,000 residents commenting on the plan, sparking mass protests. Complaints against Naumov’s administration have also piled up due to the administration’s failure to manage winter weather emergencies and stalled transit projects. trade.title: Officials Seek to Reassure Public After Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute Worker’s Death
trade.summary_en: Consumer safety watchdog Rospotrebnadzor said the lab worker who died last week was diagnosed with “pneumonia of unknown etiology.”
trade.content: Russian health authorities maintain that the health situation in Siberia’s Irkutsk region remains stable amid concerns surrounding the death of a lab worker at a local anti-plague facility, state media reported Sunday. The female employee of the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute of Siberia and the Far East was hospitalized last Tuesday with symptoms of severe pneumonia and died on Thursday. The lab worker was diagnosed with “pneumonia of unknown etiology,” according to a statement from consumer safety watchdog Rospotrebnadzor cited by Interfax. Media reports have described the suspected infection as pneumonic plague, which affects the lungs and can spread between humans through respiratory droplets. Alexei Tsydenov, head of the neighboring republic of Buryatia, initially claimed the employee had died of the plague, before modifying his statement with the word “maybe.” Rospotrebnadzor said that laboratory analysis of material from the patient did not reveal any microorganisms associated with her work handling dangerous pathogens. Earlier reports claimed the lab worker may have broken a test tube containing live bacteria. According to Interfax, the institute’s special commission and Rospotrebnadzor concluded that no emergency or security breach had occurred. The watchdog noted that no other infectious disease complaints had been registered among institute employees over the preceding 10 days. Rospotrebnadzor said all close contacts were placed under medical observation with daily laboratory testing, which detected two cases of Covid-19 and two cases of rhinovirus, but no other infections. Irkutsk region Governor Igor Kobzev said in a video published Monday that family members and close relatives under quarantine could be discharged next week. Local media reported that, contrary to earlier reports, area hospitals continued to operate on standard schedules aside from localized precautions. The Kremlin on Monday referred all questions about the issue to Rospotrebnadzor. U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Monday that Washington was closely monitoring the situation. "We're watching and monitoring it closely," Rubio told reporters before leaving for a trip to Europe. "I don't think it's cause for alarm, but it is cause for focus and a cause just to keep an eye on it." Rubio, citing what Russia has released about the death, said it seemed there was a worker in the lab who was infected and there was concern the disease may have spread internally. "There's very limited travel between the U.S. and Russia , obviously,” he said. "But like anything else, something like that gets out, it just quickly spreads." A European Commission spokesperson said Monday that Europe was also “very closely” monitoring the situation. “We are aware of the reports concerning the laboratory incident in Russia, seemingly involving a pathogen-causing plague,” the spokesperson said. Plague is endemic to Siberia, the location of the ​first known prehistoric human outbreak, as the bacterium that causes it, Yersinia pestis, is present among the ​small wild mammals in its vast wilderness and their fleas. It is rare for Russia ns ⁠to fall ill with plague, however, though cases in other parts of the world — notably Africa — occur ​every year. Reuters contributed reporting.

trade.title: Dozens Detained at Moscow Communist Party Rally
trade.summary_en: These were the largest detentions at a Communist Party rally since Russia invaded Ukraine in 2022.
trade.content: Oct. 5, 2026 SOTAvision Moscow police detained around 60 people on Sunday during a Communist Party rally commemorating the 1993 constitutional crisis, after the event spiraled into a protest against alleged fraud during last month’s parliamentary elections. An estimated 2,000 people gathered for an annual memorial honoring those killed during an Oct. 4, 1993, standoff when President Boris Yeltsin ordered tanks to shell the Supreme Soviet parliament building to dissolve opposition to his administration. Eyewitnesses told the Telegram news channel Ostorozhno Novosti that police officers charged into the crowd after chants of slogans like “Down with the Tsar!” “Freedom for political prisoners!” and “For fair elections!” broke out against the ruling United Russia party. United Russia won a record number of seats in the State Duma during the country’s first wartime parliamentary elections last month. The Communist Party — the largest Kremlin-approved systemic opposition faction — won fewer seats than in previous elections. The Communist Party said 65 “mostly young people” were detained at the tail end of the rally on Sunday afternoon. “Efforts are underway to release the detainees and provide them with the necessary help,” the party said in a statement on its Telegram channel. Moscow police detained around 60 people on Sunday during a Communist Party rally commemorating the 1993 constitutional crisis, after the event spiraled into a protest against alleged fraud during last month’s parliamentary elections. The independent outlet Sotavision reported that authorities held several participants overnight pending court hearings. News outlets underscored that authorities had approved the rally. The exiled outlet Agentstvo reported that these were the largest detentions at a Communist Party rally since Russia invaded Ukraine in 2022. On Monday morning, Communist Party leadership issued a statement challenging the voting process and electoral pressure on its candidates. trade.title: Russia Says It Hit Kyiv Bridge, 2 Vessels in Black Sea
trade.summary_en: Russia's military said it targeted a route Kyiv used to transport troops and military cargo.
trade.content: Russia hit on Sunday the Northern bridge over the Dnipro river in Kyiv, targeting a route used to transport troops and military cargo, the Russian Defense Ministry said. The ministry also said it hit two dry cargo vessels carrying military equipment to the port of Odesa in the northwestern Black Sea. In an earlier statement, the ministry said that Russian forces had struck a dry cargo vessel east of Odesa overnight, as well as a Nova Poshta logistics center in Chornomorsk and a data center in Odesa. On Sunday, Russia promised to intensify strikes on Ukraine after Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky told Reuters that Kyiv would step up attacks on Russian oil refineries. The ministry said air defense forces had intercepted and destroyed 559 Ukrainian drones between 8 p.m Moscow time (5 p.m. GMT) on Saturday and 8 a.m. Moscow time (5 a.m. GMT) on Sunday over multiple Russian regions and above the Azov and Black seas. Reuters could not independently verify the claims made by either side of the conflict. A Message from The Moscow Times: Dear readers, We are facing unprecedented challenges. trade.title: OPEC+ Agrees to Keep November Oil Output Targets Steady
trade.summary_en: OPEC+ has been raising output targets for much of 2026 after years of production cuts, but most of the increases stayed on paper.
trade.content: OPEC+ agreed to keep oil production targets steady for November at a meeting on Sunday, the producer group said, in line with expectations that further output policy adjustments are unlikely until next year. Seven core members of the group comprising the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries and allies including Russia made the decision for November in a brief online meeting on Sunday. The core members are Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Algeria, Kazakhstan and Oman. Gulf OPEC+ producers have been pumping well below output targets in the face of continuing export disruptions from the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran, with exports fluctuating at 60% to 80% of normal levels in recent months. “The OPEC+ group of seven kept their production ceilings unchanged, in line with market expectations. That said, despite rising flows through the Strait of Hormuz, their output levels remain well below quota,” said UBS analyst Giovanni Staunovo. “Consequently, the oil market remains tight.” Oil prices had dropped on Friday after European leaders agreed to U.S. President Donald Trump's request to release diesel reserves. Even so, Brent crude remains above $100 a barrel, up from about $73 before the Iran war started in late February. OUTPUT HIKES HAVE BEEN LARGELY ON PAPER THIS YEAR The Iran war has also delayed the group's output capacity review — crucial to determine members’ 2027 output quotas — because it has thrown estimates of future production potential into uncertainty, industry sources told Reuters last week. OPEC+ has been raising output targets for much of 2026 after years of production cuts, but most of the increases stayed on paper because of the Middle East conflict. The seven core OPEC+ members pumped 25 million barrels per day in August, up 630,000 bpd from July, yet still roughly 5 million bpd below prewar levels in February, OPEC data shows. The seven hold their next meeting on Nov. 1. OPEC+ still has about 2 million bpd of output cuts in place covering most members. It needs the result of the capacity review to decide how to distribute increases and any changes to output are unlikely before 2027, sources have said. A separate OPEC+ ministerial group called the Joint Ministerial Monitoring Committee (JMMC), which does not decide policy, also met on Sunday to review the market. trade.summary_en: Moscow said Russian forces would step up attacks on military facilities, defense industry sites and related infrastructure.
trade.content: Russia will intensify strikes on Kyiv and other parts of Ukraine, the Russian Defense Ministry said on Sunday, responding to an interview with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky in which he vowed increased attacks on Russian refineries. The ministry said Russian forces would step up attacks on military facilities, defense industry sites and related infrastructure in Kyiv and elsewhere in Ukraine. The intensifying campaign has seriously disrupted life for the capital's 3 million residents ahead of the bitter winter months. The Russian Defense Ministry said its recent strikes on Kyiv and other Ukrainian regions were a response to what it described as attacks by Kyiv on civilian targets inside Russia. trade.title: Germany's Merz Arrives in Kyiv to the Sound of Sirens and Explosions
trade.summary_en: “I will tell President Zelensky today: 'You can continue to count on our help,'” Merz said.
trade.content: The sound of air raid sirens and explosions rang out in Ukraine's capital Kyiv on Sunday as German Chancellor Friedrich Merz arrived for a visit to show support for President Volodymyr Zelensky amid escalating Russian attacks. Merz will announce a package of measures including the release of 1 billion euros ($1.13 billion) in military aid and 350 million euros for repairs in the energy sector, German government officials said. A deal for joint production of various kinds of drones is also due to be finalised. “I traveled to Kyiv today because Ukraine needs all our support in the coming weeks,” Merz said, adding that Russian forces were bombing towns, residential buildings and heating plants. “If Russia is not stopped, sooner or later its war machine will turn against us.” “I will tell President Zelensky today: 'You can continue to count on our help,'” Merz said. Four air raid alerts were heard in Kyiv on Sunday morning, and explosions and air defense systems also sounded across the city. One of the Russian strikes hit the Northern Bridge across the Dnipro River, damaging its roadway, Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said on Telegram. He said the strike had also damaged a hot water supply system in the area. Russia has been attacking Kyiv's bridges since last week in an effort to disrupt links between the capital's two banks and logistics routes between central and eastern Ukraine. MERZ SEEKS PROGRESS ON EU-BACKED REFORMS The German chancellor is accompanied by Economy Minister Katherina Reiche and an economic delegation including executives from Siemens Energy, Hensoldt, Diehl Defense, Quantum Systems and other companies. Merz is also expected to press the Ukrainian government for progress on reforms requested by EU partners, including in the fight against corruption. Zelensky said on Wednesday, after speaking to Merz by phone, that Ukraine would soon finalize a deal with Germany for the production of drones, missiles and related software. A key focus of the agreement is expected to be the rapid production of anti-jet drones, which Quantum, a German defense-technology company, has successfully tested. Since the summer, Russia has used dozens of high-speed jet attack drones daily to target civilian and military infrastructure. In April, Quantum and Ukrainian manufacturer WIY Drones announced the creation of Quantum WIY Industries, a joint venture to produce the Strila interceptor drone and related air-defense technologies. INCREASED COOPERATION ON LONG-RANGE WEAPONS The deal also involves the joint development and production of weapons with a range of more than 1,000 kilometers (600 miles) that Ukraine can use to launch attacks deep inside Russia. On Thursday, Merz said Germany would not be intimidated by the rising number of hybrid attacks by Russia on European states. Russia's Foreign Ministry said on Saturday that Moscow would continue to systematically hit targets in Ukraine in what it said were retaliatory strikes for Ukrainian attacks on Russia in recent months. It warned foreign nationals and diplomatic staff against staying in or traveling to Ukraine. Zelensky told Reuters on Saturday his country's armed forces would double down on their attacks on oil refineries in Russia in response to Moscow's “new doctrine” of escalating attacks on civilian infrastructure, which he said was aimed at forcing residents of Kyiv and other cities to flee. trade.title: Ukraine Will Hit Russian Refineries in Response to Moscow's ‘New Doctrine’ of Airstrikes
trade.summary_en: Zelensky says Russia's shift represents Putin's desire to appear strong at a time when his military is losing ground in a key frontline region.
trade.content: Ukraine will double down on attacking Russian oil refineries in response to a new policy of airstrikes by Moscow designed to force people to abandon Kyiv and other cities, but will not target civilians, President Volodymyr Zelensky said. Ukrainian intelligence has obtained documents showing that Russian leader Vladimir Putin had issued a “new doctrine” of military attacks on a much broader range of civilian targets ahead of winter, Zelensky said. “We saw documents and we know that they allow them to attack infrastructure ... logistics ... roads, schools, hospitals, to pressure people to leave the capital, leave different cities,” Zelensky said. “This is the goal of the operation.” Driving the shift in policy, Zelensky said, was Putin's desire to appear strong at a time when his military was losing ground in a key frontline region and sustaining higher levels of casualties. The Kremlin was not available to comment on Saturday. But in a statement urging foreign nationals to leave Kyiv, the Russian Foreign Ministry said Moscow would continue to systematically hit targets in what it said were retaliatory strikes for Ukrainian attacks on Russia in recent months. Both sides deny deliberately targeting civilians. Counteroffensive in Donbas Zelensky said an ongoing Ukrainian counteroffensive, code-named “Vivaldi,” had recaptured around 140 sq km (54 sq miles) of Ukraine's eastern Donbas region, which Russia has said it must control in its entirety as a condition for any peace deal. In recent weeks, U.S. President Donald Trump's administration has sought to revive talks to end the four-year-old conflict — Europe's bloodiest since World War Two. The U.S. leader last month urged Ukraine to refrain from hitting Russian oil installations, saying that was sending global diesel prices surging. But Zelensky, speaking as air raid sirens blared outside the gilded halls of the presidential offices, said he had received no indications from Russia that Putin was interested in peace talks or discussing a ceasefire on energy infrastructure. Over the past week, the Ukrainian capital has come under persistent attack by Russian drones and missiles targeting energy and telecoms assets, road and rail infrastructure. For the first time, Russia has targeted the bridges across the Dnipro River connecting east and west Kyiv. Zelensky said Ukraine would respond to the change in tactics by Moscow, but would not respond in kind by targeting civilian infrastructure indiscriminately. “We have to respond in any way (we can). With their attacks on our energy, we have to respond on their energy. First of all, oil refiners: what gives money to them for this war,” Zelensky said in English. “But we will not respond, of course, just like them, on any civilian objects.” Support from Europe After the Trump administration invited Putin to attend a G20 summit in Miami in December and discussed business deals with Russian envoys, Zelensky urged Washington not to normalise relations with Russia before ensuring a return to peace. Zelensky said he would be happy to meet Putin for peace talks at the G20, but he warned the U.S. not to believe in “illusions” that Russia would end hostilities if it gained control of Donbas. “It's not fair just to normalize,” said Zelensky, dressed in his trademark black T-shirt and military-style jacket. Any resumption of economic and diplomatic ties with the West had to be in return for peace, he said: “Because peace is more important than any kind of economy.” While the U.S. has proposed resuming trilateral talks in the coming weeks in the UAE, Zelensky noted that an exact date and location for the technical-level conversations had not been set. Ukrainian officials warn that Russia has stockpiled hundreds of ballistic missiles ahead of an expected winter onslaught against electricity and water infrastructure. Last winter, the worst of the war, Russian strikes left swathes of the country without electricity and heating for days at a time. Since the summer, Moscow has also begun launching dozens of fast and relatively cheap jet-powered Shahed drones a day at Ukraine, whose air defenses have struggled as its previous generation of interceptor drones are too slow to catch them. Zelensky said Ukraine had been forced to rely heavily on its fighter aircraft — F-16s and MiGs — to down around 60% of the Russian jet-powered drones, but supplies of 20 mm ammunition for the planes were running low. Kyiv was urgently working on other solutions — including boosting its jamming capabilities, he said. In the second half of October, it should receive its first shipment of small, cheap air defense missiles capable of hitting the new Shaheds. Last week, Zelensky said Ukraine was developing five models of new interceptor drones capable of downing the jet Shaheds. trade.title: Russia Pledges to Continue Massive Strikes on Kyiv, Urges Foreign Diplomats to Leave City
trade.summary_en: In a statement, the Russian Foreign Ministry said its attacks were in response to Ukraine's "terrorist acts."
trade.content: Russia said on Saturday it would continue to carry out targeted retaliatory strikes on Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities and urged foreign nationals and diplomats to leave the capital. In a statement, the Russian Foreign Ministry said that “in response to the Ukrainian Armed Forces' terrorist acts against the civilian population and civilian infrastructure of our country, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation are continuing to systematically carry out targeted strikes on military facilities in Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities.” “The Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs once again warns foreign nationals, including diplomatic mission staff, against staying in Ukraine or travelling to its territory.” “Responsibility for any adverse consequences lies entirely with those who ignore this warning,” the ministry said. Russia has recently escalated strikes on infrastructure in the Ukrainian capital, hitting a bridge across the Dnipro river in an air attack on Saturday. The intensifying campaign has upended life for the capital's 3 million residents ahead of the bitter winter months. Russian President Vladimir Putin said this week that Ukraine was paying the price for its own attacks on Russia and would continue to do so as Moscow's forces systematically strike different targets there. Both Russia and Ukraine have stepped up attacks on the other side's grain vessels in the Black Sea in recent months, while Russian oil refineries and other enterprises continue to come under Ukrainian shelling and Ukrainian drones kill civilians in Russian border regions. trade.title: U.S.-Russia Talks on Ukraine Involve Multi-Billion Dollar Oil Deal, NYT Reports
trade.summary_en: Putin reportedly raised the deal during a Sept. 5 meeting with Witkoff and Kushner at the Kremlin.
trade.content: The Trump administration’s talks with Russia on ending the war in Ukraine have expanded to include a multibillion-dollar oil deal that would benefit Middle Eastern business executives with ties to U.S. negotiators Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, the New York Times reported on Saturday. The deal, which is contingent on approval from the U.S. government and the Kremlin, involves a sprawling set of oil fields, refineries and gas stations around the world owned by Russian energy group Lukoil, according to the report. The White House, the U.S. Treasury Department and Lukoil didn't respond to requests for comment outside regular business hours. The group pursuing the deal includes U.S. investor and billionaire Todd Boehly, two Middle Eastern groups that have done business with Kushner or Witkoff's family, and an arm of the U.S. government, the newspaper said. Russian President Vladimir Putin raised the deal during a Sept. 5 meeting with Witkoff and Kushner at the Kremlin, the NYT said citing people familiar with the meeting. Putin proposed completing the deal as a way to show Russians they could do business with the United States, one of the people said. trade.title: Supply chain resilience starts before disruption: Why collaboration and visibility matter
trade.summary_en: <p>Stronger supplier intelligence helps manufacturers identify risk and respond faster to disruption.</p>
trade.content: A supplier bankruptcy. A component shortage. A sudden regulatory change. Today’s manufacturers can be thrown off course by a single disruption. The difference between organizations that struggle and those that recover quickly often comes down to one factor: resilience built into their product development and supply chain process before a crisis occurs. While resilience is frequently viewed as the ability to bounce back from a disruption, leading manufacturers increasingly recognize it as the ability to anticipate, respond, and adapt without compromising quality, timelines, or customer commitments. Achieving that level of readiness depends heavily on supplier collaboration, supply chain intelligence, visibility, and access to reliable information. These capabilities form the foundation of a resilient supply chain, particularly when organizations need to respond quickly to unexpected change. Collaboration Is the Foundation of Resilience Many supply chain breakdowns begin with seemingly simple issues, such as disconnected systems, inconsistent documentation, or siloed communication. During periods of stability, these gaps can remain hidden. During disruption, however, they can quickly lead to delays, rework, and costly mistakes. Organizations that establish structured collaboration processes are better positioned to: Address supplier issues quickly Evaluate alternative sourcing options Maintain alignment across teams Reduce the risk of quality or compliance problems In practice, resilience is about creating the operational foundation that enables effective decision-making when challenges arise. Early Risk Signals Require Clear Communication One of the most valuable yet often overlooked capabilities within supply chain operations is the ability to capture and track supplier-reported issues early on. Suppliers are frequently the first to identify emerging risks, whether related to material shortages, quality concerns, capacity constraints, or end-of-life notifications. Without a structured method for identifying and managing these issues, critical information can become trapped in emails, spreadsheets, or disconnected conversations. trade.title: Why supply chain visibility works best when data is shared
trade.summary_en: <p>See how shared product data can close supply chain visibility gaps.</p>
trade.content: A product crosses many boundaries on its way from the manufacturer to the end customer; suppliers, carriers, distributors, warehouses, and retailers all play an important role in the journey. At each handoff, data about that product is keyed or scanned into new systems and interpreted in a new context. Unfortunately, while the pallet or parcel moves quickly, the information about it may not. Many organizations have invested heavily in supply chain visibility tools over the past decade, and retail, manufacturing, and logistics organizations generally have at least some capacity to collect data. Even so, a third of today’s challenges stem from how frequently data is lost or disconnected as shipments move between systems and trading partners. “Progress has certainly been made, and companies understand that visibility and traceability are very important,” says Liz Sertl, senior director, supply chain visibility at GS1 US , a global, non-profit standards organization. “But much of that is limited to their own internal operations, and they need to start thinking externally as well. Real visibility can’t happen without the exchange of data between trading partners.” The obstacle, then, becomes interoperability. Different organizations use different systems and processes. As such, each may describe the same product differently. That leaves trading partners stuck with manual look-up tables and cross-reference documentation to reconcile inventory, even in the most straightforward exchanges. That disconnect shows up when analyzing scan data, with 70% of logistics operations reporting barcode readability issues weekly. Data gaps create inventory management problems Consumer expectations have complicated issues. Demands for faster, more reliable delivery continue to trend upward, but retailers can’t reliably promise one-hour or same-day delivery if they can’t see their inventory; B2B buyers have similarly run out of patience with long wait times and poor visibility. Establishing an accurate view of on-shelf and warehouse availability ties in directly with upstream visibility. After all, knowing what’s on hand is only half of the solution; the other half is knowing what’s coming. Dive Brief: FedEx has launched a new delivery option that offers an extra security layer for high-value and sensitive shipments, according to a Sept. 16 news release . The offering, called FedEx Authenticated Delivery, uses QR code authentication to ensure packages are only released to an authorized recipient and reduce the risk of fraud or theft, per the release. Upon delivery, a recipient at the destination address must provide the QR code to the FedEx driver for scanning and validation. "The service is particularly well-suited for shipments where added security is especially important, including luxury goods, electronics, healthcare, aerospace, collectibles, and other high-value items," the release said. Package theft has been an ongoing challenge for shippers and delivery providers, and ensuring the security of a shipment is especially critical in sectors like healthcare where patient outcomes can be on the line . “The future of delivery isn’t just moving packages quickly. It’s about building greater trust throughout the delivery process,” said Neil Gibson, FedEx SVP of global customer experience, in the release. trade.content: About Policy Offices Press Office Press Releases 2026 October Chair’s Statement of the G20 Trade Ministerial October 02, 2026 MILWAUKEE – Yesterday, Ambassador Jamieson Greer released a statement following the G20 Trade Ministerial in Milwaukee, Wisconsin in his capacity as the Chair of the G20 Trade Ministerial. “This week’s G20 Trade Ministerial in Milwaukee was a success. It is especially significant that the entire G20 was able to reach consensus on the statement on the weaponization of food through coercive trade actions,” said Ambassador Greer . “We also had constructive meetings on the sidelines regarding global diesel supplies which contributed to the anticipated release of more diesel into the global market. G20 Trade Ministers also had candid and productive discussions regarding eliminating forced labor in global supply chains, addressing structural excess capacity and production, and reforming the Most–Favored Nation principle (MFN).” “In addition, I commend Mexico and Argentina in joining the United States in a statement on eliminating forced labor in global supply chains,” continued Ambassador Greer . “While I am disappointed that the G20 Trade Ministers did not reach consensus on this issue, I am hopeful that discussions on this topic will continue and that other economies will join us in taking increased action to combat forced labor in global supply chains. In addition, many G20 members expressed resolve to address structural excess capacity and production in key sectors of concern. I am disappointed that a handful of members rejected creating a pathway toward cooperative action. Finally, I’m encouraged that members across the development spectrum indicated that they see merit in considering how the MFN principle might be improved to address today’s global trade environment.” Read the full statement here . ###

trade.content: About Policy Offices Press Office Press Releases 2026 September Ambassador Greer Delivers Opening Remarks at the 2026 G20 Trade Ministerial September 30, 2026 MILWAUKEE — Today, Ambassador Jamieson Greer delivered opening remarks at the G20 Trade Ministerial as the United States prepares to host the G20 Leaders’ Summit for the first time since 2009 on American soil. During his remarks, Ambassador Greer highlighted the success of President Trump’s use of tariffs and trade deals to reduce our trade deficit, reinforce domestic supply chains, and bring balance to the global trading order. Ambassador Greer also laid out the four workstreams for the G20 Trade Ministerial and underscored the importance of reaching a consensus on these topics. “Starting last year, the United States took action, using a combination of tariffs and bilateral deals to reduce our trade deficit, make our supply chains more resilient, and bring fairness, reciprocity, and balance to the global economy. This week, we gather to discuss these pressing issues for the trading system,” said Ambassador Greer . “There are four workstreams the U.S. Presidency has focused on over the course of the year: the weaponization of food, structural excess capacity and production, the Most-Favored-Nation principle, and forced labor in global supply chains. Over the next two days, we will discuss these issues in depth and it is my intent that we leave Milwaukee with a clearer sense of urgency and a recognition of the need for action.” Read his full remarks as prepared here . ###

trade.content: As Prepared for Delivery on September 30, 2026 Milwaukee, Wisconsin Good afternoon ministers and delegates. I would like to officially welcome you to Milwaukee for the G20 Trade Ministerial meeting. Milwaukee is the “Machine Shop of the World,” a center for innovation and services, and is located within a key agricultural state. The city is emblematic of the type of economy the United States wants to encourage—one oriented towards production, and all that comes with it. It is special that we are able to convene in the Pfister Hotel. First opened in 1893, the Pfister was at the cutting edge of engineering and design, with a fireproof construction, self-produced electricity, and even individual thermostats in every room. Over its 130-year life, the Pfister has borne witness to its share of historical events and important gatherings. I’d like to tell you about one of them. In November 1959, John F. Kennedy—then a young senator embarking on his presidential campaign—gave a major policy address in this very ballroom. Kennedy decried the loss of American competitiveness: declining production of steel, machinery, tools, energy, and agricultural products. He reminded his listeners about the importance of technological innovation and industrial investment. He worried about the erosion of productive capacity in critical sectors and the consequences of expanding non-market policies and practices. That was 67 years ago. But unfortunately, those elements of his speech are very relevant today. The speech was entitled “The Years the Locusts Have Eaten.” That, itself, is a reference to a quote by Winston Churchill about the dithering and failure to take strong policy actions in the lead up to World War II. This same framing applies to the global trading system today. To quote Kennedy’s remarks: slavish fidelity to multilateral rules has resulted in “years of drift, of falling behind, of postponing decision.” For more than a decade, the global economy has been beset by macroeconomic imbalances, structural excess capacity and production, forced labor, and economic coercion. And yet, the response by the world’s economies has been mostly talk. Consider that it was back in 2016 that the leaders of all our countries committed at the G20 to address excess industrial capacity.
